lines.en: I knock on Ami's door and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲响 Ami 的房门，等她来应门。

lines.en: I wound up getting sidetracked and showed up a bit later than usual tonight.
lines.zh: 结果我被岔开了心思，今晚比平时来得晚了一些。

lines.en: I wouldn’t be surprised if Ami and Maya were already getting ready to go to bed at this point.
lines.zh: 这个点，就算 Ami 和 Maya 已经准备上床睡觉，我也不会意外。

lines.en: : Sensei?...
lines.zh: : Sensei？……

lines.en: : Is that you?
lines.zh: : 是你吗？

lines.en: : It is.
lines.zh: : 是我。

lines.en: I hear a deep breath from behind the door.
lines.zh: 我听见门后传来一声深深的呼吸。

lines.en: Ami holds the air in for several seconds before letting it back out.
lines.zh: Ami 屏住那口气，几秒后才缓缓吐出。

lines.en: After that, she lets something else in.
lines.zh: 然后，她放别的东西进来。

lines.en: Something that, unlike oxygen, will only kill her in the end.
lines.zh: 那东西不像氧气，到最后只会杀死她。

lines.en: : The door is open.
lines.zh: : 门没锁。

lines.en: I grip the handle.
lines.zh: 我握住门把。

lines.en: I open the door.
lines.zh: 我打开门。

lines.en: And I come face to face with a girl who loves me more than anyone.
lines.zh: 与一个比任何人都爱我的女孩四目相对。

lines.en: : Hey...What are you doing here so late? I didn't think you were going to show up today.
lines.zh: : 嗨……这么晚你来干嘛？我还以为你今天不会来了。

lines.en: : Especially since it's...the weekend and everything.
lines.zh: : 毕竟……毕竟是周末什么的。

lines.en: : What would it being the weekend have to do with whether or not I come here?
lines.zh: : 是不是周末，跟我来不来这里有什么关系？

lines.en: : It's just...well, you normally do other stuff on the weekends, don't you?
lines.zh: : 就是……嗯，你周末一般都有别的安排，不是吗？

lines.en: : Just out of curiosity, what sort of life do you think I live when I'm away from you?
lines.zh: : 纯属好奇，你觉得我不在你身边的时候，过的是一种什么样的生活？

lines.en: : Idunno. But whatever it is, I hope it’s something I’d approve of.
lines.zh: : 不知道诶。但不管是什么，我希望是我会认可的那种。

lines.en: : Remember that if anything bad ever happens to you, it's kind of like that bad thing is happening to me as well.
lines.zh: : 你要记住，你要是出了什么不好的事，就好像那件不好的事也发生在我身上一样。

lines.en: : So...make sure you’re staying safe out there. And don’t forget to check in every once in a while.
lines.zh: : 所以……在外面一定要注意安全。还有，别忘了偶尔报个平安。

lines.en: : Sometimes, I feel like you’re even more of a parent than I am.
lines.zh: : 有时候我觉得，你比我更像家长。

lines.en: : Hahah...I don't really know about that...
lines.zh: : 哈哈……那倒不至于……

lines.en: : I just love you a lot and felt like reminding you, that’s all.
lines.zh: : 我只是很爱你，想提醒你一下，仅此而已。

lines.en: : Thanks, Ami.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Ami。

lines.en: : Thanks Ami what?
lines.zh: : 「谢了 Ami」什么？

lines.en: I sigh to myself, knowing full well what she wants to hear.
lines.zh: 我暗自叹气，心里清楚她想听什么。

lines.en: : I love you too.
lines.zh: : 我也爱你。

lines.en: I mask the reluctance in my voice by reaching out and ruffling Ami’s hair, and she rubs her head against me like a cat excited to be pet after a long day away from its owner.
lines.zh: 我伸手揉乱 Ami 的头发，掩饰住声音里的不情愿；她则像一只离开主人一整天、兴奋等着被撸的猫，把脑袋往我身上蹭。

lines.en: Honestly, at this point, I don’t think I’m going to be able to avoid saying I love Ami. Not when she's...not only dependent on it, but...
lines.zh: 说实话，事到如今，我觉得「我爱 Ami」这句话已经避不开了。尤其是她……不仅依赖它，而且……

lines.en: I mean...just look at how happy she is right now.
lines.zh: 我是说……你看看她现在有多开心。

lines.en: From nothing more than three words.
lines.zh: 仅仅因为三个字。

lines.en: I don't get it.
lines.zh: 我不懂。

lines.en: : Heheh...If you don't cut it out, my hair is gonna be all crazy tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 呵呵……你再不收手，我明天头发就要炸了。

lines.en: : Did you just take a shower? It's wet.
lines.zh: : 你刚洗完澡？头发是湿的。

lines.en: : Mhm. And you should know by now how long it takes for my hair to dry.
lines.zh: : 嗯。你应该早知道我的头发要晾多久了。

lines.en: : Well, you've got more of it than basically everyone else in the class combined so...yeah. That's going to happen.
lines.zh: : 谁让你的头发比全班加起来还多呢……所以嘛，会这样很正常。

lines.en: I ignore Ami's suggestion to stop messing with her hair and take even more of it into my hands, letting it fall through my fingers like-
lines.zh: 我没理会 Ami 让我住手的建议，反而把更多头发拢进手心，任它从指缝间滑落，像——

lines.en: Like-
I had a thought, but the thought went away.
lines.zh: 我本来有个念头，但那个念头消失了。

lines.en: Ami lets out a sigh, finally opening her eyes an...uncertain amount of time later.
lines.zh: Ami 叹了口气，在……说不清过了多久之后，终于睁开眼睛。

lines.en: : Oh well...I guess I can’t stop you from messing with me even if I try.
lines.zh: : 算了……反正就算我想拦，也拦不住你摆弄我。

lines.en: : That’s right. You’re my [niece], which means I can do whatever I want to you, whenever I want to.
lines.zh: : 没错。你是我的 [niece]，所以我想对你做什么、什么时候做，都随我。

lines.en: : Hahah...Well...You're definitely not wrong about that.
lines.zh: : 哈哈……嗯……这一点你绝对没说错。

lines.en: : Where's Maya, by the way? I figured she'd be here right now with how late it is.
lines.zh: : 对了，Maya 呢？这么晚了，我以为她会在。

lines.en: : Maya’s...actually staying somewhere else tonight...So I’m here alone.
lines.zh: : Maya……今晚其实住别处……所以我一个人在这里。

lines.en: : Really? Where is she-
lines.zh: : 是吗？她去——

lines.en: : Can we not talk about Maya right now, please?
lines.zh: : 我们现在能不能别谈 Maya，拜托？

lines.en: : Oh. Uhh...I'm sorry?
lines.zh: : 哦。呃……抱歉。

lines.en: : You don't have to apologize. It's just...
lines.zh: : 不用道歉。只是……

lines.en: : Don't you maybe wanna ask me about, like...if I’m comfortable being here by myself? Or...something like that?
lines.zh: : 你是不是该问问，比如……我一个人待在这里会不会不安？或者……类似的话？

lines.en: : I mean, I’ve been late coming home a few times in the past and you’ve never really said anything about it.
lines.zh: : 我以前也有好几次晚归，你从来没说什么。

lines.en: : Is being alone something you’re afraid of?
lines.zh: : 你害怕一个人待着吗？

lines.en: : Without really getting into it...it's probably my biggest fear of all.
lines.zh: : 不细说的话……那大概是我最深的恐惧。

lines.en: : Just...not really in the way you're talking about. You know?
lines.zh: : 只是……不是你说的那种怕法。你懂吗？

lines.en: : And...And it's not like I enjoy being alone. So even if I'm not scared, that doesn't mean I want things to stay like this.
lines.zh: : 而且……而且我也不是喜欢一个人待着。所以就算不怕，也不代表我想让一切照旧。

lines.en: : I’m sure you could always ask to crash with one of the other girls. I can't imagine they'd have a problem with-
lines.zh: : 你随时可以去跟其他女孩挤一挤嘛。我不觉得她们会介意——

lines.en: : I think I'd...prefer if someone else stayed here with me instead.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我……更希望有另一个人留下来陪我。

lines.en: : Is that an invitation?
lines.zh: : 这算邀请吗？

lines.en: : If I say yes...will you stay with me tonight?
lines.zh: : 要是我说是……你今晚愿意留下来陪我吗？

lines.en: : Sure. But, just to be sure, you’re positive Maya's not coming back, right? Because I can't imagine she'd be happy to find me here at this hour.
lines.zh: : 当然。不过确认一下，Maya 肯定不会回来了吧？我实在无法想象她这个点看到我在这儿会高兴。

lines.en: : Didn't I ask you not to talk about her right now?
lines.zh: : 我不是说了现在别提她吗？

lines.en: : I didn't mean anything by it. I'm just trying to make sure we don't wind up in the middle of some misunderstanding.
lines.zh: : 我没有别的意思。我只是想确认我们不会卷进什么误会里。

lines.en: : Would it really be a misunderstanding?
lines.zh: : 那真的是误会吗？

lines.en: : What was that? I couldn't-
lines.zh: : 你说什么？我没听——

lines.en: : Umm...if it’s okay with you...I thought it might be nice if the two of us...slept in my bed together.
lines.zh: : 那个……如果你不介意的话……我想，我们俩……一起睡我床上，应该会很好。

lines.en: : I know it's small and that it would make more sense for you to just sleep in Maya's, but...
lines.zh: : 我知道床很小，你去睡 Maya 的那张才更合理，但是……

lines.en: : I really want to be with you tonight, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 今晚我真的想和你在一起，Sensei。

lines.en: : I’m fine with that. Are you sure you're comfortable with it, though?
lines.zh: : 我没问题。不过你确定你自己舒服吗？

lines.en: : O-Of course I'm comfortable with it! We've been doing that sort of thing forever, haven't we?
lines.zh: : 当、当然舒服！这种事我们不是一直都在做吗？

lines.en: : Just think of...how many times I've fallen asleep in your arms and...
lines.zh: : 你想想……我在你怀里睡着过多少次，还有……

lines.en: : And how safe they made me feel...
lines.zh: : 你的怀抱让我多安心……

lines.en: : Remember when you cuddled me on the couch the other day? I loved that. And I was able to fall asleep right away.
lines.zh: : 还记得前几天你在沙发上抱着我吗？我好喜欢那样。我一下子就睡着了。

lines.en: : So...if you cuddle me again...
lines.zh: : 所以……你要是再抱抱我……

lines.en: : I, ummm...
lines.zh: : 我，那个……

lines.en: : You're not really going to make me spell it out for you, are you?
lines.zh: : 你不会真要我把话说明白吧？

lines.en: As much as I would love having her 'spell it out' for me, she obviously doesn’t have to.
lines.zh: 尽管我很乐意让她把话「说明白」，但显然不必了。

lines.en: Is an open invitation to sleep in her bed strange considering she's a teenage girl and I'm nothing more than a secondhand, stand-in father with the faintest trace of my blood somewhere inside of her?
lines.zh: 一个女高中生公然邀请同床，而我不过是个二手的、替班的父亲，血液在她体内只残留着最淡的一丝——这件事奇怪吗？

lines.en: Yes.
lines.zh: 奇怪。

lines.en: It would be one thing if she were still much younger.
lines.zh: 要是她还小得多，倒还说得过去。

lines.en: It would be one thing if she were too young to recreationally entertain the thought of the two of us as anything more than what we truly are.
lines.zh: 要是她还小到无法把「我们俩超越真实关系的可能」当成消遣来幻想，倒还说得过去。

lines.en: But I guess that what we truly are on the inside is just a mess of veins and arteries coursing through us like wires. Machine hearts and mechanical brains- all incessantly malfunctioning.
lines.zh: 但说到底，我们的内里不过是一团乱麻般的血管，像电线一样在体内奔流。机器的心脏，机械的大脑——全都在不停歇地故障。

lines.en: What we truly are is empty despite even those artificial components.
lines.zh: 剥掉那些人造零件，我们的内里其实是空的。

lines.en: But if we latch on tightly enough to one another, we might be able to make one whole machine.
lines.zh: 可只要我们彼此咬合得够紧，或许就能拼成一台完整的机器。

lines.en: I guess when you look at us as nothing more than different coats of carbon, the parts we wish to exchange with one another don't mean much.
lines.zh: 若把我们看成不过是几层不同的碳壳，那我们想交换的那些零件，其实无关紧要。

lines.en: I guess when you look at us as nothing more than two uniquely shaped masses of flesh that we can spill ourselves all over one another and it won't mean anything.
lines.zh: 若把我们看成不过是两团形状各异、可以互相倾泻的血肉，那一切都不再有任何意义。

lines.en: So, no. This girl does not need to spell anything out for me.
lines.zh: 所以，不。这女孩不需要向我说明任何事。

lines.en: For there are not enough letters in the alphabet to properly convey the thoughts that I have and desires I must either suppress or fall victim to here in this very bedroom.
lines.zh: 因为字母表的字母，根本不够拼写我此刻的念头，以及在这个卧室里我必须压制、否则就会沦为猎物的欲望。

lines.en: : Umm...Sensei?...
lines.zh: : 那个……Sensei？……

lines.en: : Let's go to bed.
lines.zh: : 我们睡吧。

lines.en: Ami gets on the mattress first, but she doesn't retreat beneath the covers.
lines.zh: Ami 先上了床垫，却没有缩进被子里。

lines.en: I do the same and, soon enough, the disgusting misled lifeforms we are begin to merge into one horrific monstrosity of forbidden desire and untapped passion.
lines.zh: 我跟着上去，不多时，我们这两团可悲又误入歧途的生命，开始融合成一只禁忌欲望与未启情热的骇人怪物。

lines.en: She faces me and pierces through my skull with the most beautiful eyes I have ever seen.
lines.zh: 她面对着我，用我见过最美的眼睛，径直刺穿我的头骨。

lines.en: Do you believe in God?
lines.zh: 你相信神吗？

lines.en: I like to say I don't, but the truth is I am scared.
lines.zh: 我喜欢说自己不信，但真相是我怕。

lines.en: I am scared that he or she or it or they or that might exist.
lines.zh: 我怕那个「他」，或「她」，或「它」，或「他们」，或那个「什么」真的存在。

lines.en: And I am scared that these eyes belong to him or her or it or them or that.
lines.zh: 我怕这双眼睛属于他，或她，或它，或他们，或那个「什么」。

lines.en: There is no other explanation for how much of the world I see inside of them.
lines.zh: 否则，我在其中看见的整个世界，无从解释。

lines.en: I lose track of how long we stare at each other for.
lines.zh: 我数不清我们对视了多久。

lines.en: For all I know, we could be days into this exchange right now- locked in a state of stasis that will soon spell our undoing as it is us alone that have ceased to be.
lines.zh: 天知道这场对视是不是已经持续了几天——我们锁死在停滞里，很快就会走向毁灭，因为唯独我们停止了存在。

lines.en: Soon, I will need to make a decision.
lines.zh: 很快，我必须做一个决定。

lines.en: I can feel it approaching quicker than the expedited delivery of blood from my machine heart through the wires of my body.
lines.zh: 我能感觉到它正在逼近，比我的机器心脏经由身体的电线紧急输送血液还要快。

lines.en: I can feel the earth begin to shake.
lines.zh: 我能感觉到大地开始震颤。

lines.en: : Hey...
: This feels kinda weird, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 这样感觉有点怪，对吧？

lines.en: : Should I turn around?
lines.zh: : 要不要我转过身去？

lines.en: : You can do whatever you want. I don’t really care.
lines.zh: : 你想怎样都行。我不太在乎。

lines.en: : Really?
lines.zh: : 真的？

lines.en: : I think...I’ll stay like this for a little while then.
lines.zh: : 那……我想再这样待一会儿。

lines.en: : This isn't too romantic for you?
lines.zh: : 对你来说，这不会太浪漫了吗？

lines.en: : What if I want it to be romantic?
lines.zh: : 要是我想要浪漫呢？

lines.en: : Then you have a problem.
lines.zh: : 那你就有麻烦了。

lines.en: : So do you, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你也一样，Sensei。

lines.en: : We're each others' problems.
lines.zh: : 我们是彼此的麻烦。

lines.en: : But no one can see us in here.
lines.zh: : 但在这里，没人看得见我们。

lines.en: : It’s like our own little world.
lines.zh: : 就像只属于我们的小世界。

lines.en: : But...you know what?
lines.zh: : 不过……你知道吗？

lines.en: : Even if anyone could see us in here...I wouldn't care at all.
lines.zh: : 就算有人能看见我们……我也毫不在意。

lines.en: : You’re my favorite person in the entire universe. And as long as you’re happy here, I’m happy.
lines.zh: : 你是整个宇宙里我最喜欢的人。只要你在这里快乐，我就快乐。

lines.en: : Are you happy here, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你在这里快乐吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : What does it mean to be happy, exactly?
lines.zh: : 「快乐」到底意味着什么？

lines.en: : Can you answer my question first before asking something that big and vague?
lines.zh: : 你能不能先回答我的问题，再问那么大那么虚的？

lines.en: : Not without understanding it.
lines.zh: : 不懂它，我没法答。

lines.en: : Then...isn't being happy just...not worrying about anything?...
lines.zh: : 那……所谓快乐，不就只是……什么都不担忧吗？……

lines.en: : Come to think of it, describing happiness is kinda hard, huh?
lines.zh: : 说起来，描述「快乐」还真是件难事啊？

lines.en: : Are you worried about anything right now, Ami?
lines.zh: : 你现在有什么担忧的事吗，Ami？

lines.en: : I'm not.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: : Are you?
lines.zh: : 你呢？

lines.en: : I'm not.
lines.zh: : 也没有。

lines.en: : So...does that mean you're happy then?
lines.zh: : 那……这么说你是快乐的？

lines.en: : As close as I’ll ever be, I guess.
lines.zh: : 大概，是我这辈子能有多近就有多近了。

lines.en: : Oh yeah? You can’t get any closer?
lines.zh: : 是吗？不能再近一点？

lines.en: : There's not really any way of knowing until I get there, right?
lines.zh: : 不到那一步，谁也不知道吧？

lines.en: : Hmm...
: I have an idea.
lines.zh: : 我有个主意。

lines.en: Ami gets even closer to me and entangles her fingers with mine.
lines.zh: Ami 靠得更近了，手指缠上我的手指。

lines.en: I think of them like enoki mushrooms, poking out of the ground and invading the garden that is the same hand I use to pleasure myself to all types of horrible thoughts.
lines.zh: 我把它们想成金针菇，从土里钻出来，入侵那座花园——正是这只手，曾对着各种可怕的念头自我取乐。

lines.en: Even ones like this.
lines.zh: 连这样的念头也算。

lines.en: Ones that don't belong anywhere near this fragile creature.
lines.zh: 那些根本不该靠近这脆弱生物的念头。

lines.en: Ones that I will force on her regardless because the light of her prism is so faded that it appears as if she wants them.
lines.zh: 而我仍会把它们强加于她——因为她那棱镜的光已黯淡得仿佛在渴求它们。

lines.en: Her face is close enough for me to taste the mint of toothpaste clinging to the air periodically pushed out from between her lips in between breaths.
lines.zh: 她的脸近得能让我尝到牙膏的薄荷味——那气味随着她呼吸的间隙，从唇间周期性地吐出。

lines.en: I wish she'd hold it in.
lines.zh: 真希望她能屏住。

lines.en: I wish she'd stop holding me.
lines.zh: 真希望她能松开我。

lines.en: : Are you happier yet?
lines.zh: : 现在更快乐了吗？

lines.en: : You think my happiness is in direct relation to how close we are?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我的快乐，跟我们有多近直接挂钩？

lines.en: : I think my happiness is in direct relation to how close we are. And I think that you're just like me, sooooo...
lines.zh: : 我觉得我的快乐，确实跟我们有多近直接挂钩。而我觉得你和我一样，所——以——……

lines.en: : Maybe you're right, then.
lines.zh: : 那也许你说得对。

lines.en: : Heheh...I thought so.
lines.zh: : 呵呵……我就知道。

lines.en: : I’m really happy right now, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我现在真的超幸福，Sensei。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t mind staying like this for the rest of forever.
lines.zh: : 就这样待到永远，我也不介意。

lines.en: : Or at least until Maya gets back.
lines.zh: : 或者至少待到 Maya 回来。

lines.en: : You're not supposed to be talking about Maya right now.
lines.zh: : 现在不许提 Maya 哦。

lines.en: : Right, right. Sorry.
lines.zh: : 好好好。抱歉。

lines.en: : Here's another idea, then.
lines.zh: : 那我还有个主意。

lines.en: : How about we play a little game?
lines.zh: : 我们来玩个小游戏怎么样？

lines.en: : What kind of game did you have in mind?
lines.zh: : 什么样的游戏？

lines.en: : A question game. We both have to ask each other something, and we need to answer as honestly as possible or the other person can do whatever they want to the liar.
